name: bot-notch
description: Show Claude Code sessions, permission prompts and questions in a native macOS notch; answer them from the screen edge.

helper_path.title: Custom notch app (optional)
helper_path.description: Leave empty: the plugin downloads and runs the prebuilt notch app by itself. Set an absolute path only to run your own build of helper/ (keep BotNotch_BotNotch.bundle beside it).

approval_wait_seconds.title: Answer-from-Notch window (seconds)
approval_wait_seconds.description: How long a permission prompt or AskUserQuestion stays answerable in Notch. Answering in Claude Code first always wins. 0 shows status only.
